cpmplus.w7pose.body.title: Turn/move the whole body
cpmplus.w7pose.body.intro: Turns or moves the checked parts together around one pivot. Head, arms and legs follow the body and don't come apart. The preview shows on the model while this dialog is open.
cpmplus.w7pose.body.rot.desc: Same axes as Blockbench rotation keys.
cpmplus.w7pose.body.off.desc: Offset after the turn. No scale: CPM ignores scale on body parts.
cpmplus.w7pose.body.roots.desc: All checked by default. Uncheck the ones that should stay still.
cpmplus.w7pose.body.head.desc: Uncheck to keep the head following the aim.
cpmplus.w7pose.body.convert: Convert the animation to non-additive (exact in game)
cpmplus.w7pose.body.convert.desc: In an additive animation Minecraft adds its normal swing and look on top, so the pose may move while walking/looking. Non-additive stays exactly like in Blockbench.
cpmplus.w7pose.body.warn.additive: This animation is additive: in game Minecraft adds its normal swing and look, so the pose may move while walking or looking (not exact). To match, convert it to non-additive below or use 'No Minecraft animation' on the parts.
cpmplus.w7pose.body.warn.lock: Locking these parts switches Minecraft's swing/look off on them while this animation plays.
cpmplus.w7pose.body.warn.global: Skipped parts (global rotation is not supported by CPM): %s
cpmplus.w7pose.body.warn.scale: '%s' has scale keys: CPM ignores scale on body parts.
cpmplus.w7pose.body.warn.bezier: %s bezier keys were made linear so the movement doesn't come apart.
cpmplus.w7pose.body.warn.molang: %s formula (molang) keys were replaced by numbers.
cpmplus.w7pose.body.err.noRoots: No body part (vanilla root) to move.
cpmplus.w7pose.body.err.ramp: The ramp needs at least 1 frame between start and end.
cpmplus.w7pose.body.err.limit: The position of '%s' at %s s would be %s px, and the CPM file can only store up to ±48 px. Use a smaller offset, another pivot or move fewer parts.
cpmplus.w7pose.body.err.length: The animation would last %s s, and a CPM animation can last at most 32.767 s. Choose an earlier end.
cpmplus.w7pose.body.err.frames: The animation would need %s different frames, and CPM keeps at most %s. Use a shorter range or apply to one frame only.
